descriptionPlain:
About AppNation
We build AI-powered mobile apps that reach millions of users worldwide.
Since 2021, AppNation has been creating products across AI, productivity, and mobile experiences. Our apps, including Genie, Translate AI, and Arch, have reached 100M+ users globally and ranked among the top apps in 30+ countries.
We are a team of builders, designers, and engineers who move fast, take ownership, and create products used by millions.
About the Role
We’re looking for a Brand Manager to shape how we are perceived - both as a product company and as a workplace. From social presence to events and candidate touchpoints, you will build a strong, consistent narrative that attracts high-potential talent and strengthens our overall brand.
Working closely with People & Culture, marketing, and leadership, you’ll turn our culture, products, and way of working into a scalable and compelling brand.

About AppNation

We build AI-powered mobile apps that reach millions of users worldwide.

Since 2021, AppNation has been creating products across AI, productivity, and mobile experiences. Our apps, including Genie, Translate AI, and Arch, have reached 100M+ users globally and ranked among the top apps in 30+ countries.

We are a team of builders, designers, and engineers who move fast, take ownership, and create products used by millions.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Brand Manager to shape how we are perceived - both as a product company and as a workplace. From social presence to events and candidate touchpoints, you will build a strong, consistent narrative that attracts high-potential talent and strengthens our overall brand.

Working closely with People & Culture, marketing, and leadership, you’ll turn our culture, products, and way of working into a scalable and compelling brand.

lists.content:
• Own and shape AppNation’s brand and employer brand strategy, strengthening awareness, credibility, and positioning across all channels.

  • Lead content and social media, creating engaging stories that reflect our products, culture, and way of working.

  • Manage and improve brand touchpoints, including our website, careers pages, digital assets, and company merchandise.

  • Shape company culture and employee experience through internal initiatives, storytelling, and communication.

  • Own and enhance the candidate experience across all touchpoints, from first impression to offer.

  • Build communities and lead internal and external events, meetups, and university collaborations.

  • Track brand and employer brand performance, using data and insights to improve engagement, reach, and hiring outcomes.

• 2-5 years of experience in brand, content, social media, community, or employer branding.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to create engaging and authentic content.

  • Experience managing social media accounts, following content trends, and building communities.

  • Understanding of company culture, employee experience, and internal engagement.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects, timelines, and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong analytical skills and understanding of how brand impacts growth, hiring, and retention.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.

• Build and scale products reaching millions of users globally.

  • Work with talented people in a fast-moving AI-first environment.

  • Take ownership and see your impact directly in the products you build.

  • Grow quickly with opportunities to lead projects and shape technical decisions.

  • Enjoy competitive compensation and benefits, including private health insurance, meal and commute support, relocation support, and flexible working options.

description:
About AppNation

We build AI-powered mobile apps that reach millions of users worldwide.

Since 2021, AppNation has been creating products across AI, productivity, and mobile experiences. Our apps, including Genie, Translate AI, and Arch, have reached 100M+ users globally and ranked among the top apps in 30+ countries.

We are a team of builders, designers, and engineers who move fast, take ownership, and create products used by millions.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Legal & Compliance Counsel to help us build and scale world-class mobile experiences.

You’ll work closely with our Product, Marketing, and other teams to provide practical legal guidance across our mobile products and day-to-day operations. From app store compliance (App Store, Google Play) and product launches to intellectual property and privacy, you’ll take ownership of legal processes and help teams move quickly while staying compliant.

lists.content:
• Provide day-to-day legal advice to Product, Marketing, and other teams, proactively identifying and mitigating legal risks across mobile apps, product development, creative and commercial initiatives.

  • Monitor App Store and other relevant platform policies, identify compliance requirements, and support teams throughout product development, launch, and post-launch operations.

  • Advise on intellectual property, including trademark registration, copyright protection, and brand protection.

  • Support data privacy and consumer protection compliance, ensuring our products, marketing activities, and internal practices align with applicable laws and regulations.

  • Advise on legal and regulatory requirements for AI-powered features, including emerging AI regulations and platform-specific policies.

  • Coordinate legal projects with external law firms and counsel, managing communication, timelines, and internal stakeholders to ensure effective execution.

  • Own end-to-end legal processes, from research and documentation to implementation and follow-up, while staying current on developments in technology, mobile apps, platform policies, intellectual property, and data privacy.

• 3+ years of relevant legal experience, preferably in technology, digital products, mobile applications, or a fast-paced business environment.

  • Strong knowledge of commercial law, intellectual property, data privacy, consumer protection, and technology-related regulations.

  • Familiarity with App Store and other digital platform policies, with the ability to interpret and apply compliance requirements to mobile applications and AI-powered products.

  • Ability to independently manage end-to-end legal processes, from identifying legal risks and conducting research to developing practical solutions and ensuring implementation.

  • Experience coordinating with external law firms and managing legal projects involving multiple internal stakeholders.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate complex legal requirements into clear, actionable guidance for non-legal teams.

  • A proactive, detail-oriented, and solution-oriented mindset, with strong ownership and the ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment.

  • Fluency in written and spoken English.

• Build and scale products reaching millions of users globally.

  • Work with talented people in a fast-moving AI-first environment.

  • Take ownership and see your impact directly in the products you build.

  • Grow quickly with opportunities to lead projects and shape technical decisions.

  • Enjoy competitive compensation and benefits, including private health insurance, meal and commute support, relocation support, and flexible working options.

lists.content:
• Plan, execute, and optimize multi-channel user acquisition campaigns across Google Ads, Apple Search Ads, Meta, TikTok, and other growth platforms.

  • Drive Apple Search Ads performance and contribute to ASO efforts, aligning paid and organic strategies to maximize store visibility and conversion.

  • Shape ad concepts and messaging together with the Creative team, defining hypotheses, and turning performance insights into actionable improvements.

  • Analyze campaign performance using MMPs (AppsFlyer/Adjust), dashboards, and key metrics such as ROAS, LTV, and retention.

  • Take ownership of the growth funnel, from install to subscription, optimizing for long-term revenue and monetization.

  • Collaborate closely with Product teams to translate marketing insights into better user experiences and business outcomes.

  • Build strong platform partnerships and explore new channels, strategies, and experiments to unlock scalable growth opportunities.

• 3+ years of experience managing user acquisition campaigns for mobile apps across iOS and Android.

  • Proven expertise with major UA platforms such as Google Ads, Apple Search Ads, Meta, and TikTok Ads.

  • Hands-on experience with Apple Search Ads and/or ASO is strongly preferred.

  • Solid understanding of mobile attribution, SKAN, and performance marketing principles (AppLovin and Web-to-App experience are a plus).

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify opportunities, and turn insights into growth decisions.

  • Experience developing creative strategies and collaborating with design teams to improve ad performance.

  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to manage budgets, prioritize tasks, and scale multiple products.

  • Fluent in English with strong communication skills.

• Build and scale products reaching millions of users globally.

  • Work with talented people in a fast-moving AI-first environment.

  • Take ownership and see your impact directly in the products you build.
